# datadog_ai_gateway_provider (Resource)

Provides a Datadog AI Gateway provider resource. A provider connects the AI Gateway to a model vendor through an integration account, and its models become routable under its slug. This resource is in Preview.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datadog_ai_gateway_provider" "openai" {
  name                   = "OpenAI production"
  slug                   = "openai-prod"
  known_provider         = "openai"
  integration_account_id = "<integration_account_id>"
  cost_multiplier        = 1.2
}

resource "datadog_ai_gateway_provider" "bedrock" {
  name                   = "Bedrock us-east-1"
  slug                   = "bedrock-us-east-1"
  known_provider         = "bedrock"
  integration_account_id = "<integration_account_id>"

  integration_config = {
    bedrock_region = "us-east-1"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `known_provider` (String) Provider implementation. Use `custom` for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Changing it forces a new provider. Valid values are `custom`, `anthropic`, `openai`, `azure_openai`, `bedrock`, `gemini`, `baseten`, `fireworks`, `together`, `typesafe`, `azure_foundry`.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the provider.
- `slug` (String) Routing identifier of the provider. Changing it forces a new provider. Must contain only letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores.

### Optional

- `cost_multiplier` (Number) Multiplier applied to provider costs. Must be greater than 0 and at most 1000000. The API defaults to 1. Value must be between 0.000000 and 1000000.000000.
- `integration_account_id` (String) ID of the integration account that holds the vendor credentials. Changing it forces a new provider.
- `integration_config` (Attributes) Provider-specific integration settings. The API returns this block for every `custom` provider, so it is computed when unset. Changing any field forces a new provider. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integration_config))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--integration_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `integration_config`

Optional:

- `bedrock_region` (String) AWS region, for `bedrock` providers.
- `foundry_project` (String) Azure AI Foundry project name, for `azure_foundry` providers.
- `foundry_resource_id` (String) ARM resource ID of the Azure AI Foundry resource, for `azure_foundry` providers.
- `location` (String) GCP location, for `gemini` providers.
- `project_id` (String) GCP project ID, for `gemini` providers.
- `supported_operations` (List of String) Operations that a `custom` provider discovered and manually added models support. The API defaults to `OPENAI_CHAT_COMPLETIONS`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import datadog_ai_gateway_provider.openai "<provider_id>"
```
